title: Earning Cashback from Eco-Friendly Vendors
summary: Explains how to earn 2.0% cashback on eligible purchases from certified eco-friendly (“green”) vendors using a Hunter Green business debit/payment instrument. Covers the ~2,500-vendor network, eligibility at purchase time, when cashback accrues, tracking, and possible reversal for refunds/disputes plus common exclusions for non-certified merchants/ineligible transaction types.
faqs: What cashback rate do I earn with certified eco-friendly vendors?
How do I ensure a vendor qualifies for the 2.0% cashback at the time of purchase?
When does cashback accrue and where can I track accumulated rewards?
What happens to cashback if my purchase is refunded or disputed?
Which purchases are excluded from earning the 2.0% cashback (e.g., non-certified merchants)?
About how many certified green vendors are in the network and what categories does it cover?
